items.source: rootObject - the root object against which to evaluate the expression
items.translation: rootObject - 用于评估表达式的根对象

items.source: EvaluationException - if there is a problem during evaluation
items.translation: EvaluationException - 如果在评估期间出现问题

items.source: EvaluationException - if there is a problem determining the type
items.translation: EvaluationException - 如果确定类型时出现问题

items.source: context - the context in which to evaluate the expression
items.translation: context - 用于评估表达式的上下文

items.source: the evaluation result
items.translation: 评估结果

items.source:
The supplied root object will be used as an override for any default root object
configured in the context.
items.translation: 提供的根对象将用作上下文中配置的默认根对象的覆盖项。

items.source:
If the result of the evaluation does not match (and cannot be converted to)
the expected result type then an exception will be thrown.
items.translation: 如果评估结果与预期结果类型不匹配（且无法转换为该类型），将抛出异常。

items.source: EvaluationException - if there is a problem determining if it is writable
items.translation: EvaluationException - 如果确定是否可写时出现问题

items.source: desiredResultType - the type the caller would like the result to be
items.translation: desiredResultType - 调用者希望结果返回的类型

items.source: the most general type of value that can be set in this context
items.translation: 此上下文中可设置的最通用的值类型

items.source: a type descriptor for values that can be set in this context
items.translation: 用于在此上下文中设置值的类型描述符

items.source: Return the most general type that can be passed to the setValue(EvaluationContext, Object) method using the default context.
items.translation: 返回可以使用默认上下文传递给 setValue(EvaluationContext, Object) 方法的最通用类型。

items.source: Return the most general type that can be passed to the setValue(Object, Object) method using the default context.
items.translation: 使用默认上下文，可以传递给 setValue(Object, Object) 方法的通用类型是 `Object`。

items.source: Return the most general type that can be passed to the setValue(EvaluationContext, Object) method for the given context.
items.translation: 返回可以传递给给定上下文的 setValue(EvaluationContext, Object) 方法的最通用类型。

items.source: Return a descriptor for the most general type that can be passed to the setValue(Object, Object) method using the default context.
items.translation: 使用默认上下文返回可以传递给 setValue(Object, Object) 方法的最通用类型的描述符。

items.source: Return a descriptor for the most general type that can be passed to the setValue(EvaluationContext, Object) method for the given context.
items.translation: 返回一个描述符，表示可以传递给给定上下文的 setValue(EvaluationContext, Object) 方法的最通用类型。

items.source: Evaluate this expression in the default context and return the result of evaluation.
items.translation: 在默认上下文中评估此表达式并返回评估结果。

items.source:
Evaluate this expression in the default context against the specified root object
and return the result of evaluation.
items.translation: 在默认上下文中评估此表达式，并返回针对指定根对象的评估结果。

items.source: Evaluate this expression in the provided context and return the result of evaluation.
items.translation: 在此上下文中评估此表达式并返回计算结果。

items.source: Determine if this expression can be written to, i.e.
items.translation: 确定该表达式是否可以写入，即

items.source: Set this expression in the provided context to the value provided.
items.translation: 将此表达式在提供的上下文中设置为提供的值。

items.source: true if the expression is writable; false otherwise
items.translation: true 表示表达式可写；否则为 false。

items.source: value - the new value
items.translation: value - 新值

items.source: Encapsulates the details of a previously parsed expression string.
items.translation: 封装了先前解析的表达式字符串的详细信息。

items.source: Provides a common abstraction for expression evaluation.
items.translation: 提供用于表达式求值的通用抽象。

items.source: Return the most general type that can be passed to the setValue(EvaluationContext, Object, Object) method for the given context.
items.translation: 返回可以传递给给定上下文的 setValue(EvaluationContext, Object, Object) 方法的最通用类型。

items.source: Return a descriptor for the most general type that can be passed to the setValue(EvaluationContext, Object, Object) method for the given context.
items.translation: 返回一个描述符，该描述符对应于可以传递给给定上下文的 setValue(EvaluationContext, Object, Object) 方法的最通用类型。

items.source: Return a descriptor for the most general type that can be passed to one of the setValue(...) methods using the default context.
items.translation: 返回一个描述符，用于指定使用默认上下文时可以传递给其中一个 `setValue(...)` 方法的最通用类型。

items.source: Return the original string used to create this expression (unmodified).
items.translation: 返回用于创建此表达式的原始字符串（未修改）。

items.source:
Evaluate this expression in the provided context against the specified root object
and return the result of evaluation.
items.translation: 在提供的上下文中评估此表达式，并返回评估结果。

items.source: Set this expression in the default context to the value provided.
items.translation: 将此表达式在默认上下文中设置为提供的值。

items.source: Determine if this expression can be written to, i.e. setValue() can be called.
items.translation: 确定是否可以写入此表达式，即是否可以调用 setValue()。

items.source: context - the context in which the expression should be checked
items.translation: context - 表达式应检查的上下文

items.source: context - the context in which to set the value of the expression
items.translation: context - 设置表达式值的上下文

items.source: Keith Donald, Andy Clement, Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Keith Donald，Andy Clement，Juergen Hoeller

items.source: the original expression string
items.translation: 原始表达式字符串
